provider: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin
attribution: Geoportal Berlin / ALKIS Berlin Flurstücke (Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin), dl-de/zero-2-0; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Bounded candidate-area coverage only: EPSG:25833 extent [387500, 5816500, 392500, 5821500] intersects 11,434 parcels; edge parcels are returned as whole geometries.
Citywide coverage (403,526 parcels; approximately 420 MB raw) is not imported. It would require tiled extents and streaming normalization; the current pipeline holds all records in memory.
afl is the official booked ALKIS area. geometry_area_m2 is a derived planar EPSG:25833 geometry area and may differ (observed area ratio p50 0.9995; outliers range from 0.29 to 3.38).
This is ALKIS state per service revision 2026-09-22 with monthly updates; beg is available per feature, but no per-feature edition is supplied.
Parcels are cadastral units and provide no evidence about ownership, use, buildability, development permission, availability, tenancy, or sale.
uuid is the stable ALKIS object ID; fsko may change when parcels are split or merged.
Relationships to buildings, addresses, and planning are geometric in EPSG:25833, not legal assignments.
